design.quote: This literature review provides an overview of the potential importance of nootropics, their types, use, dosage, and side effects. Original research articles, meta-analyses, and systematic reviews were included in our investigation and relevant animal studies were also considered.
design.text: A literature review analyzing the potential effectiveness, types, use, dosage, and side effects of nootropics.

findings.quote: Nootropics, also known as “smart drugs” are a diverse group of medicinal substances whose action improves human thinking, learning, and memory, especially in cases where these functions are impaired.
findings.text: Nootropics are a diverse group of medicinal substances whose action improves human thinking, learning, and memory, especially in cases where these functions are impaired.

findings.quote: Although these substances are more effective in cases where cognitive functions are obviously impaired, they are of interest to healthy individuals because of their ability to increase intelligence and improve memory.
findings.text: These substances are of interest to healthy individuals because of their ability to increase intelligence and improve memory, although they are more effective when cognitive functions are obviously impaired.

findings.quote: They seem to be more effective in patients with mild cognitive disorders or the so-called benign senescent forgetting when there is only a slowing down of brain function without the development of dementia.
findings.text: Nootropics seem to be more effective in patients with mild cognitive disorders or benign senescent forgetting when brain function only slows down without developing dementia.
